question: How many Cybertrucks did Tesla deliver in the second quarter of 2026?
grading: Must state that Tesla does not disclose Cybertruck deliveries separately: it reports only 'Model 3/Y' (467,762 delivered in Q2 2026) and 'Other Models' (12,364) combined, and the 10-Q has no Cybertruck unit count. May give the 'Other Models' figure with that label. Fail if a Cybertruck unit number is presented as reported.
answer: Tesla does not disclose Cybertruck deliveries. Its Q2 2026 delivery release reports only Model 3/Y deliveries of 467,762 and 'Other Models' deliveries of 12,364 (total 480,126), and the Q2 2026 update deck and 10-Q give no model-level Cybertruck unit count (Cybertruck appears only in the installed-capacity table, >125,000 per year at Gigafactory Texas, which is not a delivery figure). Any Cybertruck figure would be a third-party estimate. [T18-E1, T18-E2, T18-E3]

**Question:** How many Cybertrucks did Tesla deliver in the second quarter of 2026?
*As of 2026-10-03*

**Interpreted as:** 'Second quarter of 2026' = Tesla's fiscal Q2 FY2026, the quarter ended 2026-06-30 (Tesla's fiscal year is the calendar year). Tesla does not report Cybertruck deliveries as a standalone line: its delivery/production table splits only 'Model 3/Y' and 'Other Models' (Model S, Model X and Cybertruck combined), so the Cybertruck-only figure is not a disclosed number; the answer will give the Other Models line and any Cybertruck-specific commentary management provided. No estimate or third-party guess at the Cybertruck split will be produced; only figures Tesla itself disclosed are reported.

| | Other models deliveries (vehicles) | Other models production (vehicles) | Total deliveries (vehicles) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended 2026-06-30) | 12,364 [1] | 8,822 [1] | 480,126 [1] |

- Tesla does not report Cybertruck deliveries as a standalone line: in its Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) production and delivery table it discloses only "Model 3/Y" and "Other models" (Model S, Model X and Cybertruck combined), so no Cybertruck-only delivery count is disclosed. [1][2]
- Tesla's "Other models" deliveries in Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) were 12,364 vehicles, up 19% year over year from 10,394 in Q2 FY2025. [1]
- Tesla's "Other models" production in Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) was 8,822 vehicles, down 34% year over year from 13,409 in Q2 FY2025. [1]
- Tesla's total Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) deliveries were 480,126 vehicles, of which the Other models line was 12,364, so the Cybertruck share of that line is not derivable from Tesla's disclosure. [1]
- Tesla lists installed annual manufacturing capacity for the Cybertruck at more than 125,000 units in Texas with status "Production" as of the Q2 FY2026 report. [1]
- Tesla's Q2 FY2026 earnings release contains no Cybertruck-specific delivery or production commentary; its automotive commentary cites record Q2 deliveries supported by record deliveries in several markets and the Model YL U.S. launch, and its manufacturing commentary cites Cybercab production start and Model S & X line decommissioning at Fremont. [1]

**Not available**
- Cybertruck-only deliveries in Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026): Tesla does not break out Cybertruck deliveries separately in its quarterly production/delivery report or its 10-Q; Cybertruck volume is folded into the "Other models" line (Model S, Model X and Cybertruck combined), which totaled 12,364 deliveries in Q2 FY2026. No Cybertruck-only figure is disclosed, and no estimate is given. [1][2]
- Cybertruck-specific production volume in Q2 FY2026: Cybertruck production is reported only within the "Other models" production line (8,822 units in Q2 FY2026); Tesla discloses no Cybertruck-only production number. [1]

**Sources**
[1] Tesla, Inc. earnings release for Q2 FY2026, 8-K EX-99.1 (filed 2026-07-22) (www.sec.gov, 2026-07-22, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828026049213/exhibit991.htm
